title: The Rip in the Bag
lines: Tim has a bag of buns on his bed.
Tim tugs at the bag. It has a rip!
Ten buns tip on the bed and his lap.
Tim is sad. He runs to Dad.
Dad digs in a bin of pins and pegs.
"I have a pin. Let me fix the rip," said Dad.
Tim tips ten buns in the bag and zips it.
Tim hugs Dad. "You fix a lot," said Tim.
